context_requirements: Expression of VEGFR family receptors (KDR/FLT1/FLT4) or co-targeted kinases (KIT, PDGFRA/B, FGFR1, RET) on tumor cells
VEGF ligand availability or autocrine VEGF signaling
Endothelial or stromal components for indirect antiangiogenic effects
falsifiers: No change in VEGFR/PDGFR/FGFR target genes or downstream ERK/AKT transcriptional signatures at 6 h
No reduction in proliferation or increase in apoptosis at 24 h in any line
Strong and uniform transcriptional response across all nine lines, including lines lacking VEGFR expression
Upregulation of angiogenesis-related genes (VEGFA, KDR, FLT1) instead of downregulation

evidence.supports: Axitinib inhibits VEGFR2 and downstream AKT/ERK phosphorylation and increases apoptosis in ovarian cancer cells
VEGFR inhibitor vatalanib response is associated with HIF1α-regulated genes including LDHA, GLUT-1, VEGFR1, and VEGFR2
VEGFR inhibitor PTK787/ZK222584 reduces vessel density and tumor growth in breast cancer models
